column8: Option (Minidregg.Theory.CredentialAuthorityState.StoredCapability Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.ResourceKind.account) → Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.SubjectId → ℕ → Prop := fun stored subject account => match stored with | Option.none => False | Option.some stored => stored.head.holder = Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.Holder.subject subject ∧ Minidregg.Kernel.PayAssignmentReceiver.OwnerTargets stored.head.scope.targets account ∧ stored.head.policyId.value = account

Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.TargetSet Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.ResourceKind.account → ℕ → Prop := fun targets account => targets = Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.TargetSet.explicit {{ value := account }} ∨ targets = Minidregg.Theory.TypedAuthorization.TargetSet.under account
